user.title: Choose the master thermostat
user.description: Pick the thermostat that controls the boiler. Next you choose which of your other thermostats should follow it.

data_description.master_entity: Usually the thermostat that calls for heat from the boiler (for example your Hive thermostat).
data_description.name: Shown as the hub device name in Home Assistant.

rooms.title: Choose the rooms
rooms.description: Home Assistant knows {count} other thermostat(s). Tick the ones that should follow the master — each becomes a room, named after its area (or its own name). Untick anything that isn't a room radiator. You can rename rooms and fine-tune each one afterwards.

data_description.offset: Degrees added to the master target; can be changed per room later.
data_description.off_below: If a room's target would be below this temperature its thermostat is switched off (or set to frost protection).

abort.already_configured: That thermostat is already set up as a master.

user.title: Add rooms
user.description: {count} thermostat(s) aren't rooms yet. Tick the ones to add; each becomes a room named after its area (or its own name). Offset and cut-off apply to all of them and can be changed per room afterwards.

data_description.offset: Degrees added to the master target (-2 with a master of 20° gives 18°).
data_description.off_below: If a room's target would be below this temperature its thermostat is switched off (or set to its frost-protection temperature). More behaviour options are on each room's device page.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure room
reconfigure.description: Offset and cut-off set here are only used the first time a room is added; afterwards adjust them with the room's own entities.

error.same_as_master: That is the master thermostat. Pick a room thermostat instead.
error.already_configured: That thermostat already belongs to another room.

abort.already_configured: That thermostat already belongs to another room.
abort.no_candidates: Every thermostat Home Assistant knows about is already a room (or the master).

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Replace the weekly schedule of a room (or of the master thermostat, when you pick the hub device).

device_id.name: Room
device_id.description: The room to schedule, or the hub device to schedule the master thermostat itself.

schedule.name: Schedule
schedule.description: Days (mon..sun, or weekdays / weekend / all) mapping to a list of blocks. Each block has a time (HH:MM) and a mode: follow (master + offset; optionally its own offset), fixed (a temperature), or off. A block lasts until the next one starts. The master thermostat accepts only fixed and off.

get_schedule.name: Get schedule
get_schedule.description: Return the weekly schedule of a room or of the master thermostat, plus the block currently in effect.

device_id.name: Room
device_id.description: The room, or the hub device for the master thermostat.

clear_schedule.name: Clear schedule
clear_schedule.description: Remove the schedule so the room simply follows the master (or the master is left to its own schedule).

device_id.name: Room
device_id.description: The room, or the hub device for the master thermostat.

sync.name: Sync now
sync.description: Recompute and push targets to the thermostats right away, even if nothing changed. Useful from an automation if a thermostat tends to drift back to its own schedule.

device_id.name: Room
device_id.description: Only this room (or this hub). Leave empty to sync everything.

device_not_found.message: Device {device_id} is not a Cozy Home room or hub.
